model: REM-Net continuous B1 (WSST-only) with locked L3 MR-STFT waveform core

data_provenance.target: stored MMECG ECG, 1x1600 at 200 Hz, per-record z-scored; trained in train-fold robust-scaled space and inverted before scoring
data_provenance.scaler: median/IQR over the ENTIRE training fold only (fit_scaler)
data_provenance.split_hashes: per-fold val/test SHA256 recorded below; all 11 validation files and all 11 test files are distinct

protocol.design: strict LOSO on loso_v2; each subject is validation once and test once
protocol.checkpoint_selection: validation composite only (0.40 PCC + 0.25 (1-min(NRMSE,1)) + 0.20 max(R2,0) + 0.15 F1@100); Shape-200 excluded
protocol.composite_disclosure: NRMSE term is identically zero because NRMSE > 1 throughout; max(R2,0) is zero on negative-R2 epochs; selection is effectively PCC + waveform F1@100 (audit 2.5)
protocol.budget: 100 epochs max, patience 15, AdamW lr 1e-4, weight decay 1e-4, batch 16
protocol.state_machine: TRAINING -> CHECKPOINT_FROZEN -> TEST_EVALUATING -> COMPLETE; all 11 folds COMPLETE
protocol.test_access_rule: opened exactly once per fold, after the validation-best checkpoint was frozen

metrics.scoring_space: raw stored ECG units (per-record z-score domain, NOT millivolts)

within_fold_aggregation.waveform_and_smoothing: per-window then nanmean over the held-out subject's windows
within_fold_aggregation.region_mae: pooled across all beats in the fold

metrics.across_fold_aggregation: fold-macro mean with POPULATION standard deviation over 11 test subjects
metrics.nan_policy: nanmean inside the evaluator; observed NaN count is 0 for all 19 metrics in all 11 folds

reporting_rules.R1_rr_hr_coverage_gate: Only folds with rr_coverage >= 0.80 enter RR/HR aggregation. Fold 7 (coverage 0.0039) is excluded and reported as a failure case. Gated values: RR 44.5 +/- 30.1 ms, HR 3.39 +/- 1.83 bpm over 10 folds. Thresholds 0.5/0.8/0.9 give the same partition. The ungated 218.9 +/- 552.3 ms and 6.09 +/- 8.70 bpm in the frozen summary JSON must not be tabulated.
reporting_rules.R2_high_frequency_ratio: above_10hz_energy_ratio is reported as median 0.122 with IQR [0.083, 0.195] plus per-fold values and the maximum (1.702, fold 5). The mean 0.270 +/- 0.460 must not stand alone.
reporting_rules.R3_labels: Tables must state z-score units for RMSE/MAE/region MAE, the aggregation style per metric, 'population std across 11 folds', and keep waveform F1 separate from event-head F1.

permitted_interpretation: R2 is centred near zero across folds rather than reliably positive; the amplitude variance ratio of 0.31 documents substantial residual regression toward the mean. Amplitude collapse is mitigated, not resolved.
failure_cases: Fold 7: waveform R-peak readout failed (F1@50 = 0.0026, rr_coverage = 0.0039, lowest amplitude variance ratio 0.032) while its event head still reached F1@100 = 0.410.
limitations: Single seed (42 + fold). Headline claims require the >=3-seed confirmation in docs/METRIC_CONTRACT.md.
No same-protocol continuous baseline exists on loso_v2; the old loso baseline aggregates are BLOCKED (docs/MMECG_SPLIT_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md).
Validation composite is partially degenerate (see composite_disclosure); it was frozen before the run and was not changed.
Coverage gate R1 was defined after observing the coverage distribution; its insensitivity over 0.5-0.9 is documented in the audit.
MMECG only; no CR_RVS continuous evidence.
status: completed; metric audit done; awaiting multi-seed confirmation and same-protocol baselines
